title: The bird on the sign
logline: The tavern's sign from the front, the name on it, and the bird sitting on the sign's face over one of the letters. The name is reserved; the page draws the bird over the letter that would settle it.

panels.composition: The tavern's front sign in July light, hand-painted lettering across it, the small rainbow bird perched on the sign's face covering one letter, the door below.

characters.pose: on the sign, over a letter

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a tavern's hand-painted front sign in July light with a small rainbow bird perched on its face covering one of the letters, the door below, lettering not legible
image.notes: The name: reserved. The bird sits on the letter that would tell.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Over the letter that would tell.
